## Context

Implement the documentation, metadata, comment, and provenance recommendations approved after the F21 through F49 survey and independent filtering. F21 requires explicit Jira project selection with no default or fallback project. F28A records that GitHub Actions is active, GitHub Issues is disabled, and Issues integration is planned. F24 remains pending and is not part of this epic.

## Plan

- Execute taut-uncanny-koi for F21, F22A, and F22B.
- Execute xenophobic-allpurpose-serval for F25 and F27.
- Execute shapable-decayed-nematode for F32, F33, F34A, and F37.
- Execute bleached-unadvised-anhinga for F43A, F43B, and F44.
- Execute irritable-junior-fairyfly for F28A and F45.
- Execute pedagogish-certain-butterfly for F46, F49A, and F49B.
- Execute interested-bluecoated-illadopsis for F48.
- Execute tracker-only research story cuddlesome-amoral-oyster for F47.
- Run file-disjoint repository children in parallel worktrees. Each child owns its complete file set, and pedagogish-certain-butterfly is the sole pyproject.toml owner in this epic.
- Send every repository change through Gerrit.
- Preserve historical ADR decisions while correcting inaccurate cross references and operational examples.
- Add no mechanical prose, punctuation, vocabulary, character, or comment enforcement.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every approved recommendation in the eight child stories is implemented or recorded with its stated evidence.
- [ ] Every child story is closed without force after its own acceptance criteria pass.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Each of the seven repository children is merged to main.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Each repository merge has LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Each repository merge has no unresolved comments at submission.
- [ ] The research child records its conclusion without modifying repository files.
- [ ] The Markdown-only GitHub and Gerrit runbook child skips the full local test suite and passes its focused documentation checks.
- [ ] No child introduces mechanical writing or character enforcement.
